item.title: Portfolio & Article Website Build
item.description:
250-750 USD | I’m looking for a developer-designer who can create a clean, modern site where I can publish articles and present my portfolio in an organised, visually engaging way. The core aim is to share information—no e-commerce for now—so the structure needs to prioritise readability, simple navigation, and strong visual presentation.
Here’s what I have in mind: • A CMS (WordPress, Webflow, or a platform you recommend) that lets me add new posts and portfolio pieces without touching code. • Responsive layouts that look great on desktop, tablet, and mobile. • A blog feed for long-form articles, plus separate portfolio galleries with category filters. • Basic on-page SEO set-up and fast-loading images. • Contact page or form so visitors can reach me quickly.
Deliverables 1. Fully functional website deployed on my hosting with all sample content in place. 2. Brief hand-off guide or screen-share walkthrough so I know how to add and edit pages.

item.title: Revamp WordPress Pages & Forms
item.description:
250-750 USD | I’d like a skilled WordPress developer to strengthen two key areas of my site WWW.DONPEARSALL.COM: Homepage, the service-/product-oriented pages and the contact-driven features that turn visits into enquiries.
First, I want the service and product pages rebuilt so they look sharper, read better, and encourage action. Clean sectioning, persuasive copy placeholders, and a layout that adapts beautifully on mobile are all essential. You’re free to work with Gutenberg, Elementor, or another builder you trust, as long as the final result is lightweight and easy for me to update later.
Second, I need streamlined enquiry functionality. A form—Gravity Forms, Contact Form 7, or similar—should capture name, email, phone, and a short message, then route each submission to my inbox with autoresponder confirmation to the visitor. No payment gateway or bookings for now; the sole goal is to let prospects request a quote or ask a question quickly.
Deliverables • Redesigned home page, service/product page template implemented across existing items • One universal “Request a Quote” form placed prominently (sidebar, footer, and a dedicated page) • Basic on-page SEO essentials transferred or set up (H-tags, meta, alt text) • Clear hand-off notes or short Loom walkthrough so I can maintain content
Acceptance Criteria • Pages load without layout breaks on desktop, tablet, and phone • Enquiry form sends email successfully and shows confirmation message • All work is performed on a staging copy, then pushed live only after approval
Let me know your preferred builder, estimated turnaround, and one or two examples of similar upgrades you’ve completed.

item.title: WordPress Search Page — Phase 1 Build, Phase 2 Python API Integration
item.description:
250-750 CAD | I’m looking for a WordPress developer for a two-phase project. Please submit a fixed-price bid for Phase 1 only. I’d prefer to work with the same developer for both phases if Phase 1 goes well.
Phase 1 — Build and demo the WordPress page Build one mobile-friendly WordPress page based on my mockup. The page should let users search by product name or an 8-digit ID, including IDs with leading zeros. If a name matches multiple products, users should be able to select the correct match and view its details. Use sample data for this phase and build the page so the sample data can later be replaced with results from an API. Deliver a working demo on desktop and mobile, along with the editable WordPress page and any custom code.
Phase 2 — Connect the page to my Python API Replace the sample data with live results from my existing Python API and test the full search flow. We’ll agree on the scope and price for this phase separately after Phase 1 is approved.
In your proposal, please include your fixed price and estimated timeline for Phase 1, a link to a similar project, and a brief note about your experience connecting WordPress to an external API. I’ll share the detailed mockup and technical materials privately after a confidentiality agreement is signed.

item.title: E-Commerce Order Chatbot Build
item.description:
250-750 USD | I’m looking for a smart yet lightweight AI agent that lives inside our website chat and instantly answers one thing really well: “Where is my order?”
Core capability • The bot should recognise a customer by order number, email, or phone, connect to our store’s API, and return live order status and carrier tracking links in natural language. • Handling this first task accurately and with near-instant response time is the priority; everything else can follow later.
Tech & integration notes Our store runs on Shopify, and we already expose order data through a private REST API. I’m open to Dialogflow CX, Rasa, LangChain on OpenAI, or another framework if you can show it keeps latency low. Code must be containerised (Docker) and ready for a one-click deploy to AWS.
Deliverables 1. Working chat widget embedded on our site 2. Backend service that fetches and formats order status/tracking details 3. Simple admin panel or JSON config for API keys, intents, and fallback phrases 4. README with setup, environment variables, and hand-off instructions
Acceptance criteria • 95 %+ accuracy on sample queries drawn from our past support logs • Response time under 2 seconds end-to-end • Graceful hand-off to a human agent when confidence < 0.8 or data is missing
If you’ve built a similar order-tracking bot before, link a demo or repo so I can see it in action.

I’m looking to get this live quickly, so please outline your estimated timeline and any access requirements in your proposal.
I also need help with Instagram ads.

item.title: Build Searchable Journal Archive Platform
item.description:
3000-5000 USD | Functionality to Parse and Display Journals on Our Website
My stamp club produces a quarterly journal. The Journal is posted on our website with both the ability to browse the complete journal and search the journal. The journal search is more than just a key word search, it pulls up the complete articles with the key word being searched irrespective of the page. For example, if the article is on page 2-4 and then continues to page 10 and 11, the search will display the complete article. Similar to how a story may be organized in a Newspaper. The current functionality relies upon the individual who runs the program breaking down the content, which has not been reliable.
The club is looking to develop functionality that replaces and enhances this functionality and is owned by the club so we can use this functionality on other journals. The current functionality can be found on: https://www.collectorsclub.org/ccp/browse-search-the-ccp/ Test copies of the journal (CCP) can be obtained by using the browse selection.
Requirements: • The product must work with our current WordPress website – Please address the ease at which your proposal can be used should the club migrate away from WordPress. (You will see the current functionality is NOT integrated with WordPress. • The Club plans to transition to a commercially available Membership Plug in such as Ultimate Membership Pro or similar. If your proposal is contingent upon a specific membership Plug in please list this. We can consider a variety of membership plug-ins, beyond the standard functionality we require the ability to pro-rate a subscription. https://ultimatemembershippro.com/
- Search Functionality - • Perform Keyword search that are included in the larger website search as well as the journal only. o User can choose different categories of assets (Similar to the way WordPress allows users to Create Categories and Sub-Categories and those categories can be incorporated into a search or display.  Example of how to expand internal CCP Components:  Currently we can search by Author, Advertiser, year(s) with groupings, as well as keyword  We may want to add other categories as some point, like “Presidents Message” or “Financial Report” ect. We understand that adding the categories will require work by the club to identify the sections in journals that have been processed.  Examples of Categories outside the CCP Journals could be: Website content, Specific other Journals from other Clubs (ie. Search a journal called BNA and the CCP). We do not have these External categories yet, but would like a tool that will allow us to other sources. • We have a vast Video Library which we plan to develop transcripts. The Search should have the ability to link the Transcript to the video such that the video and transcript will appear in the search. • The ability for a user to save their research to use at a future time. • A push capability that will message a user when content is added that meets their search criteria. • The ability of researchers to leave comments about the article. o The comments must go to a Web Admin for approval before Posting (typical WordPress functionality). • Ability to identify the award willing Articles (Can be part of the Search). • The ability of the User to Click on an author’s name and be connected to an Author Profile Page – as if the Authors were users. • The ability to display content based on Membership Category (normal wordpress functionality).
- Requirements for the functionality to Parse the Journals and storage- • We understand that this will likely require a volunteer to identify the Journal Sections. The more this can be automated the better. o We need the ability to add categories. • Should be simple and easy to use by non-technical volunteers or the Journal editor. • Scalable to accommodate a future volume for the club or assets not stored on the Club server.
We are not adverse to a solution that adapts an existing product, such as WooCommerce to meet our needs. Please include the required licenses for your solution: ie. Adobe Acrobat Pro: etc. Please include information that addresses how the solution can be updated with changes in Wordpress or the assumed technology. The Club will own the solution developed and have the right to sub-license. You are welcome to share solutions that expand upon the functionality we would like, but please specify if there are any areas that will be problematic or will constitute a disproportionate cost such that the club can assess if that feature warrants our investment at this time. Thank you.

item.title: Shopify Site for Online coaching Brand
item.description:
750-1500 AUD | I need a clean, modern Shopify presence that showcases my online personal training brand, builds trust, and funnels visitors toward booking our consultations. The core objective is brand promotion rather than running a large online storefront, so aesthetics, storytelling, and smooth navigation matter more than complex inventory features.
Here’s what I have in mind: • A visually soothing theme tailored to wellness, customised with my colours, fonts, and imagery. • Clear service pages that highlight benefits, pricing, and a simple call-to-action button that can link to our existing booking app. • Space for a small product range (no more than ten skus) presented in a way that complements the service focus. • An About section crafted for authority and warmth, plus an easily editable blog for tips on skin, mindfulness, and healthy living. • Mobile-first layout, fast loading, on-page SEO basics, and integration of Google Analytics.
Please share examples of previous Shopify sites—especially any in beauty, health, or wellness—and outline what you did on each project. Your experience with theme customisation, Liquid, and basic SEO will help me choose the right partner. Once the draft site is live on my domain and I’m comfortable updating text and images myself, the project is complete.

item.title: Clone Website, Rebrand Seamlessly
item.description:

The layout, animations, and user experience should mirror the original as closely as possible; only the visual identity and wording change. The contact forms must stay fully functional and route to the email address I will provide. No payment processing or e-commerce modules are needed.
Deliverables • Pixel-accurate replication of every primary page and section found on the reference site • All contact forms recreated and tested with live email delivery • Replacement of logo, colours, text, and images with assets I supply • Clean, well-commented source files and deployment instructions so I can host the site myself
Please let me know which stack you plan to use and how long you’ll need to turn this around. I’ll share the reference URL and brand assets as soon as we start.

item.title: Construction Startup Marketing & Branding
item.description:
30-250 CAD | I run a one-person construction startup and need a digital partner who can make us visible and memorable online, then turn that visibility into real client enquiries. My priority is building brand awareness, so every channel should feel cohesive and professional while nudging prospects toward contacting me.
Here’s what I need help with most:
• Website that brings in client enquiries – a clear, conversion-focused site (WordPress or similar) with strong copy, simple lead-capture forms, on-page SEO, and basic analytics so we can see what’s working. • Social media branding and regular posts – consistent visuals, voice, and posting rhythm across Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok, or any other platform you recommend, plus a content calendar I can approve in advance. • Online advertising to reach potential clients – targeted Facebook/Instagram ads or Google Ads campaigns that stay within agreed spend and steer traffic straight to our new site or dedicated landing pages.
Please outline:
– How you’ll approach each of the three areas above. – The tools you prefer (e.g., Canva, Hootsuite, Meta Ads Manager, Google Analytics). – A realistic timeline for first deliverables and measurable milestones (followers gained, clicks, enquiries, etc.).
If you’ve helped other small or solo construction businesses before, that’s a bonus, so feel free to share examples. I’m ready to start as soon as we agree on a plan.

item.title: Counselling Website Development
item.description:
20-250 GBP | Squarespace Website SEO Optimisation and Improvements for Counselling Practice
I'm looking for an experienced Squarespace web developer or SEO specialist to help improve the visibility and performance of my existing counselling practice website.
I already have a fully functioning website for my private counselling practice, Clear Current Counselling, and I'm not looking for a complete redesign or a new website.
My main aim is to improve local search visibility, attract potential clients and make it easier for people to find out about my services and get in touch.
Existing website: https://www.clearcurrentcounselling.co.uk/
Areas I'd like support with
Local SEO: Improve visibility for relevant searches such as counsellor in Ramsgate, counselling in Thanet and counselling in East Kent.
On-page SEO: Review and optimise page titles, meta descriptions, headings, image descriptions and relevant keywords.
Website content: Identify opportunities to improve the wording and structure of existing pages so that search engines and potential clients can understand my services.
Google visibility: Check Google indexing, Google Search Console and any technical issues affecting search performance.
AI search visibility: Explore ways to improve how my practice is represented in AI-powered search tools such as ChatGPT and Google AI.
User experience: Review the website's mobile layout, navigation and contact links to make it easier for potential clients to enquire.
Enquiry journey: Ensure that contact details, introductory consultation information and calls to action are clear and accessible.
About my business
Clear Current Counselling is an independent counselling practice based in Ramsgate, Kent. I offer integrative, person-centred and trauma-informed counselling for adults and young people aged 11 and over.
I offer face-to-face sessions in Ramsgate, subject to room availability, as well as online counselling across the UK.
I am an NCPS Accredited Member and Registered Member of BACP.
What I'm looking for
I'd particularly like someone with:
Proven experience working with Squarespace websites.
Experience in local SEO and improving search visibility for small businesses.
An understanding of service-based businesses, ideally within counselling, therapy, healthcare or wellbeing.
The ability to make practical improvements directly to an existing website rather than simply providing an audit.
An understanding of website user experience and how to encourage enquiries.
Budget and scope
My current budget is approximately £100 for a one-off project.
I'm therefore looking for someone who can recommend and implement the most valuable improvements within this budget. I'm open to a fixed-price package or a small number of hours of focused work.
Please include examples of similar websites or businesses you've worked with, your relevant experience, and what you would realistically be able to achieve within my budget.
I'm not looking for guaranteed Google rankings or ongoing monthly SEO packages. I'm looking for practical, worthwhile improvements that will help my existing website reach more potential clients.

item.title: Build a Professional Website for Valterra Landscaping & Outdoor Living
item.description:
30-250 USD | Company name: Valterra Design & Build
I need a polished, responsive website that instantly communicates Valterra’s expertise in landscaping and garden design. The site must help visitors understand our services, browse a visual gallery of past outdoor transformations, and reach out through an easy-to-use contact / estimate request form.
Please review our Facebook page to understand our business, see project photos, and get a feel for our style:
Facebook: Facebook.com/ValterraDesign
Visual tone & feel • Professional, trustworthy branding with plenty of high-quality imagery of gardens, lawns, and plantings. • Clean typography and ample white space so photos take center stage.
Core functionality • Fully optimized for phones, tablets, and desktop screens. • Pages: Home, Services (landscaping & garden design focus), Portfolio/Gallery, About, Contact / Get an Estimate. • Simple CMS or page-builder setup so my team can update text and add new project photos without coding. I also want a website that I don't have to pay monthly. Using Wordpress is best. • Basic on-page SEO, fast load times, and secure hosting configuration.
Timeline I’d like to move quickly—delivery ASAP with clear milestones for design mock-ups, development, testing, and launch.
When you reply Please include links or screenshots of past work that demonstrate your ability to build visually driven, mobile-first sites. If you’ve handled similar landscaping or outdoor service projects, point those out. Briefly outline your proposed tech stack or platform, estimated timeframe, and anything you need from me to get started.

item.title: Modern Website Redesign Overhaul
item.description:
30-250 USD | My current business-oriented website does its job, but the look and feel are dated. I want a fresh, fully modern and professional redesign that covers the entire site—from the visual identity right through to page layouts and user flow.
Scope • Full-site makeover: every page, template, and component needs to be revisited, not just the homepage. • Visual upgrade: new typography, color palette, iconography, and imagery that align with a contemporary, trustworthy brand presence. • User experience: cleaner navigation, intuitive layout, and responsive design so visitors feel at home on desktop, tablet, and mobile. • Quality touches: lean code, fast load times, accessibility best practices, and SEO-friendly structure baked in from the start.
Deliverables 1. High-fidelity mock-ups or prototypes for review and sign-off. 2. Fully implemented site (CMS or custom stack—open to your recommendation) matching the approved designs. 3. Handover package: source files, style guide, and instructions for future updates.
Acceptance Criteria • Consistent modern styling across all pages. • No broken links or display issues on major browsers and common screen sizes. • Page performance scores in the green on standard tools (e.g., PageSpeed Insights). • Clear, professional aesthetic that elevates the brand.
If you have a portfolio that demonstrates similar full-site revamps for business or service websites, I’d love to see it along with a concise plan and timeline for this project.

item.title: Business Website
item.description:
30-250 USD | I want a modern, responsive website that presents my business and services professionally and also makes it easy for visitors to purchase digital products—think downloadable files or online courses—directly from the site.
Core requirements • Clean, on-brand design that highlights who we are and what we do. • Secure e-commerce flow for digital goods: product pages, cart, checkout, automatic file delivery, and basic licence or access control. • Simple content management so I can update text, images, and product listings without touching code. • Fast load times, mobile-first layout, and SEO-friendly structure. • End-to-end launch support, including domain connection and basic analytics setup (e.g., Google Analytics, Search Console).
Preferred stack I’m flexible, but popular options like WordPress + WooCommerce, Shopify, or a comparable platform that excels at digital downloads are ideal. If you have another solution that meets the same goals, feel free to suggest it.
Acceptance criteria 1. Site passes a live usability review on desktop and mobile. 2. Test purchase of a sample digital product processes correctly and instantly delivers the file or course access. 3. Admin login provided with a short walkthrough or video so I can add future products and pages myself.
Once everything is live and verified, the project is complete.

item.title: Modern Car Dealership Website Build
item.description:
250-750 GBP | I run a car sales business and need a polished, mobile-friendly website that instantly builds trust with visitors. Every vehicle must display crisp photos, pricing, key specifications, and a short description, while the site itself stays fast and easy to navigate on phones and desktops alike.
From the user’s side, I want shoppers to browse or search the stock then reach out however feels most natural—whether that’s firing off an enquiry through a simple contact form, calling or messaging me directly, or booking a test-drive slot online. Smooth, well-placed calls-to-action are essential.
On the back end, I should be able to log in through an intuitive dashboard and add, edit, or remove cars without touching code. Think drag-and-drop image uploads, fields for price, mileage, year, and spec, plus automatic formatting so every new listing looks consistent.
A clean, contemporary design, SEO-friendly structure, and solid security setup round out the project. Once complete, hand over the live site along with brief instructions (or a quick screen-share) so I can keep inventory updated going forward.

item.title: Website Improvement Review
item.description:
20-250 GBP | WordPress Technical Audit, PHP Compatibility Assessment & Hosting Migration Consultation
I'm looking for an experienced senior WordPress developer or technical consultant to conduct an independent technical assessment and consultation with me to discuss my existing website: https://www.platinum-healing.com/
My website is currently hosted and managed by HealthHosts https://www.healthhosts.com/ using their proprietary WordPress theme (HealthHosts Web49). It is running PHP 7.4.33, and my provider claims that upgrading to a supported PHP version would require significant development work and a complete website rebuild.
I have restricted WordPress access, with no access to plugins, server configuration or full administrator settings.
I require a paid technical consultation with me to investigate:
WordPress architecture: Identify the existing theme, framework, plugins, custom code, dependencies and potential limitations of the proprietary HealthHosts system.
PHP compatibility: Assess whether the website can be upgraded to PHP 8.3 or newer, identify potential compatibility issues and determine whether these could be resolved without a complete rebuild.
Website migration: Establish whether the existing WordPress installation can be migrated to an independent hosting provider, including the database, media library, content, theme and functionality.
Proprietary theme restrictions: Determine whether the HealthHosts theme is technically portable and what licensing or ownership restrictions would need clarification.
Access requirements: Identify exactly what I need to request from HealthHosts, including WordPress administrator access, SFTP/FTP, database exports, hosting control panel access, backups and theme files.
Alternative technical solutions: Evaluate whether the existing website could be upgraded, migrated, have its theme replaced while retaining the current design, or require a partial or complete rebuild.
SEO and functionality preservation: Assess how to preserve existing URLs, page structures, metadata, redirects, search rankings, forms and other website functionality during migration.
Hosting independence: Recommend a suitable independent WordPress hosting arrangement where I retain ownership and administrative control of my website.
Costs and feasibility: Provide an objective comparison of the technical work, estimated costs, risks and practical implications of each option.
What I require initially:
A one-to-one video consultation with screen sharing, a preliminary technical review recommended options and next steps.
Please explain what you can assess through publicly available information and my existing WordPress access, and what would require additional server or administrator access.
I am specifically seeking an independent technical assessment, not a quotation for a new website or a sales pitch for redesign services.
Please confirm your relevant experience with legacy WordPress installations, proprietary themes, PHP upgrades and migrations away from managed website providers, together with your consultation fee.

item.title: Install AI Chatbot on WordPress
item.description:
250-750 USD | I need someone to add a simple AI chatbot to my existing WordPress site using a ready-made plugin. I’m looking for a no-code setup, not custom development.
I’ll provide a short FAQ, a link to the full FAQ page, and a welcome message.
The setup should include: • Installing and configuring a suitable plugin. • Adding the FAQ and welcome message. • Showing the chat widget across the site and matching its colors. • Setting up a message directing visitors to the FAQ page when the bot can’t answer, if the plugin supports it. • Checking that the widget works on desktop and mobile.
Any plugin or API fees should be listed separately and approved before installation.
Please suggest a plugin and your estimated turnaround. If any requirement needs custom coding, let me know before starting.

item.title: Urban Multi-Family Floor Plan Design
item.description:
30-250 USD | I’m developing an urban multi-family residential project and need clear, buildable floor plans that show exactly how the building will sit on the site and how each unit will relate to shared open areas. The intent is to strike the right balance between the number of homes and generous communal space, specifically a landscaped courtyard or garden at ground level and a usable rooftop terrace.
Here’s what I need: • A site-responsive concept layout illustrating building footprint, access, parking (if required), and how residents move between indoor and outdoor zones. • Scaled floor plans for each level that organise the units efficiently while keeping natural light and ventilation in mind. • Integration of the courtyard/garden and rooftop terrace so they feel like extensions of everyday living rather than leftover space. • Digital files (DWG or RVT preferred) plus PDFs ready for review; layered so future adjustments are straightforward. • A brief design narrative explaining the key decisions, unit counts, and how the scheme meets zoning or setback limits.
Plans can be produced in AutoCAD, Revit, ArchiCAD, or another professional drafting package—whatever you’re most comfortable with, as long as the output is clean and editable.
I already have the site survey and municipal guidelines; once we begin, I’ll share those along with the preliminary massing studies that prompted this rethink. What I’m missing is a cohesive plan that makes the project flow, optimises unit size, and gives residents meaningful outdoor space. If you can turn those ideas into a clear, coordinated set of floor plans, let’s get started.

item.title: Mobile Detailing CRM & Web Integration
item.description:
250-750 USD | I run a mobile detailing service and need a single, cohesive system that doubles as my public-facing website and my internal CRM. On the front end I want a clean portfolio page that shows off recent jobs, then funnels visitors straight into an online scheduling flow. Customers must be able to pick a service, select their preferred date and time, and pay by credit card—ideally all without ever feeling they’ve left the site.
Behind the scenes the booking calendar should automatically assign each request based on the customer’s service address so my team is routed efficiently within our coverage areas. Once a booking is confirmed, the same platform should store customer data, service history, and payment status so I’m not bouncing between multiple tools.
If you’ve worked with systems like Jobber, Housecall Pro, Zoho, HubSpot, or you can build a custom stack that combines a responsive website with CRM, calendar logic, and Stripe (or similar) payments, let’s talk. My priority is a seamless, branded experience from portfolio browse to completed appointment, with all data living in one place and accessible on mobile.

item.title: Custom E-Commerce Store with Product Designer
item.description:
1000-6500 USD | I need a complete e-commerce website for **Urban Stitch Custom Creations**, my veteran-owned business specializing in custom apparel, personalized gifts, and awareness designs. Customers should be able to shop ready-made designs, personalize products, preview their own artwork, and request quotes for custom or bulk orders.
I want a bold, patriotic look with a black or midnight navy background, muted red accents, and warm white text. Use my logo, large product photos, and the tagline **“Creating Awareness One Design at a Time.”** The site should be easy to browse and buy from on a phone.
### Homepage and storefront
The homepage should give visitors four clear ways to get started: **Shop Ready-Made Designs, Personalize a Product, Request a Free Quote, and Explore Monthly Awareness.** Feature popular products, seasonal gift bundles, and the current awareness campaign. Include a short introduction to the business and a simple explanation of how custom ordering works.
Organize the shop into categories such as apparel, drinkware, blankets, home décor, puzzles, ornaments, and gift bundles. Product pages should show photos, pricing, sizes, colors, personalization options, estimated production and shipping times, and care instructions where applicable. Include search, product filters, a shopping cart, secure checkout, and order confirmation emails.
### Interactive product customizer
I want customers to be able to **upload their own artwork onto a blank product and see a live preview before purchasing**. They should be able to add text, move and resize their design, and see where the printable area ends. The editor should work across multiple product types, including shirts, hoodies, mugs, tumblers, and tote bags, with product-specific print areas. Save the original artwork, placement details, and preview with the order so I can produce what the customer approved.
### Custom orders and design services
Create a **Request a Free Quote** page for bulk orders, events, teams, businesses, and projects that need design help. Collect the customer’s name, email, product type, quantity, needed-by date, project details, and any inspiration files. Save inquiries where I can review them and send me an email notification for each new request. Include a services page for custom design, logo design, brand refreshes, mockups, and charity collaborations.
### About, awareness, and customer support
Create an About page with three sections covering my story as the founder, what Urban Stitch Custom Creations offers, and why monthly awareness matters to the business. Build an Awareness page where I can update the featured cause, showcase related products, and share how each campaign gives back.
Include a Contact page, FAQs, order tracking, and clear policies for shipping, returns, refunds, and personalized orders. I also need to be able to update products, prices, banners, seasonal collections, and awareness campaigns myself. Build the site with fast-loading pages, descriptive page titles, and clear headings so customers can find our products through search.

item.title: WordPress-to-WIX HOA Site Migration
item.description:
750-1500 USD | I want to move our current WordPress site, ABCPOA.net, over to WIX so the Alliance of Brunswick County Property Owners Associations (ABCPOA) can manage everything with minimal technical effort. All existing public pages, documents, images, and news posts must come across intact. Once on WIX, visitors need to keep reading the news archive, downloading documents, and—after logging in—viewing upcoming events, registering for meetings, and reaching member-only information.
Role-based access is critical. Property owners, board or committee members, and site editors each need different permission levels so the right people see the right content and up to fifteen editors can update the site whenever needed.
I also want the build to stay flexible: swap templates without starting from scratch, run smoothly on phones and tablets, and give me clear analytics on engagement and performance. Security and privacy are non-negotiable, so set up robust authentication. If Circle is the best way to handle discussions or other community functions, please weave it in alongside any other pre-built integrations that make sense for email, calendars, or document storage.
Deliverables • Fully migrated WIX site with all public content in place • Member system configured with three distinct roles and secure sign-in • Event/meeting module live and usable on mobile • Google Analytics (or native WIX reporting) connected and verified • Demonstrated ability to switch templates without content loss • Brief hand-off guide so our non-technical volunteers can maintain the site
Feel free to leverage WIX Members, WIX Events, Velo, or other native tools—just keep the workflow as straightforward as possible. Let me know your proposed approach and timeline.

item.title: Website for Local Pet Shop
item.description:
30-250 USD | I'm looking for a web developer to create a modern, well-designed website for a small independent pet shop based in the UK. We're a local business selling pet food, treats, toys, grooming products and accessories, mainly for dogs and cats.
At the moment, we don't have a proper website, and I'd like to change that. I'm not looking for a large online store or anything particularly complicated. I just want a professional website that represents the shop properly, looks trustworthy and makes it easier for local customers to find us and see what we offer.
**What I have in mind**
The homepage should give visitors a good first impression of the business. I'd like a nice header with the shop's name, a simple navigation menu and a main section with a relevant pet-related image and a short introduction. Below that, there could be a few sections highlighting our main product categories, a short description of the shop and a clear way to find our contact details.
For the products section, I'd like customers to be able to browse the types of products we sell. We mainly focus on dog food, cat food, treats, toys, collars, leads, beds and basic grooming supplies. These don't need individual product pages or prices for now. A simple layout with images, category names and short descriptions would be enough.
I'd prefer the products to be arranged in a way that doesn't make the website feel cluttered. For example, customers could select a category and see a few relevant products underneath. I don't mind whether this is done using separate pages or a simple filtering system, as long as it's easy to use.
I'd also like an About Us section. Nothing too long, just some information about the business and the fact that we're an independent local pet shop. I think this would help make the website feel a little more personal rather than looking like a generic online shop.
The contact page is quite important. It should display our address, telephone number and opening hours clearly. I'd also like a Google Maps link or an embedded map so customers can easily find the shop. A simple contact form would be useful too, allowing people to send us a message with their name, email address and enquiry.
**Design and appearance**
I don't have an exact design prepared, so I'm open to suggestions from the developer. However, I do have a general idea of how I'd like it to look.
I'd prefer a fairly modern and clean design, with natural colours such as green, beige, white or other colours that suit a pet-related business. Nothing too bright or childish. The website should feel friendly and welcoming, but still professional.
I'd also like some good-quality images of dogs, cats and pet products throughout the website. These don't need to be custom photographs, and suitable royalty-free images would be perfectly fine.
The layout should have enough space between sections, readable text and consistent styling across all pages. I don't want excessive animations, pop-ups or anything that makes the website unnecessarily complicated.
It's particularly important that the website works properly on mobile phones. I expect quite a few customers will be visiting from their phones, so the navigation, images and text should adapt to smaller screens without issues.
**Technical requirements**
I'm not particularly concerned about which technology is used. HTML, CSS and JavaScript would be fine, but I'm open to other suggestions if there's a good reason to use them.
The website should load reasonably quickly, have working navigation and include basic SEO elements such as page titles, descriptions and appropriate headings.
I don't need user accounts, online payments, shopping carts, inventory management or any advanced backend functionality.
For the contact form, I'd like to discuss a simple way of handling messages. I'm open to a basic email form service if that makes more sense than building a backend.
I'd also appreciate it if the code was reasonably organised, so making changes later wouldn't be too difficult.
**What I expect to receive**
Once the website is finished, I'd like to receive all the source files, including the HTML, CSS, JavaScript and any other files used in the project.
I'd also like a short explanation of how to run the website locally and how to change basic information such as opening hours, phone numbers, text and images.
Hosting and domain registration are not required at this stage. I may arrange those separately once I'm happy with the finished website.
Before considering the project complete, I'd like to see the website working on both desktop and mobile, check that all links work and make sure the contact form behaves as expected.

item.title: Service Booking Website with Dashboard
item.description:
30-250 USD | I run a small team that handles cleaning, moving, furniture assembly, delivery, and gardening jobs. I need a modern, mobile-friendly website that makes it effortless for visitors to land on the homepage, understand what we do at a glance, and book the help they need.
Core user flow • Visitors arrive on a polished landing page, pick a service, complete a simple booking form, choose a date and time, upload any helpful photos, and pay online and an option to pay cash. • They can just as easily request a quote when details are unclear. • Once the booking is placed, customers create (or log in to) an account where they can track job status in real time and review past orders.
Back-office requirements On my side I want a clean dashboard—accessible from any device—to view, edit, and assign incoming jobs, update progress, issue invoices or refunds, and export basic reports. Staff logins with role-based permissions are essential so the team only sees what they need.
Key expectations – Sleek, fast UI that feels current rather than templated. – Secure payment integration (Stripe or similar). – Responsive design and clear calls to action. – SEO-ready structure and Google Analytics connected. – Training or concise documentation so my team can add services, prices, and promotions without developer help.
Tech stack is open; WordPress with custom plugins, Laravel + Vue, or a React/Node build are all fine as long as performance, security, and future scalability are covered.
Deliverables 1. Live website hosted on our domain, HTTPS enabled. 2. Admin dashboard with role controls and job management. 3. Payment gateway fully tested in production mode. 4. One-page guide (or short screen-share session) explaining routine updates.
If you have previous examples of service-booking portals or dashboards you built, share the links so I can gauge fit. Let’s create a site that impresses at first click and keeps operations tidy behind the scenes.

item.title: Influencer-Driven Bump Ban Site Launch
item.description:
250-750 USD | I have already perfected BumpBan—an after-shave solution that puts an end to razor bumps—and now I need its digital home and growth engine built from the ground up within the next month.
Your mission is to create a polished, conversion-ready website (Shopify or WordPress/WooCommerce—your call), then turn it into an influencer and affiliate magnet. Getting the site online is only step one; the true priority is recruiting influencers and affiliate partners who can authentically champion the product and drive sales long-term.
Day-to-day you will: • Design and launch the site, complete with clear product storytelling, before/after visuals, and friction-free checkout. • Set up an affiliate platform such as Refersion, Tapfiliate, or ShareASale and craft compelling partner assets (unique links, discount codes, swipe copy). • Identify, reach out to, and onboard micro- and macro-influencers across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and grooming forums. • Coordinate trials, content briefs, and campaign tracking so each creator’s impact is measurable. • Manage ongoing email, social, and paid retargeting to keep momentum high.
I’m offering a modest monthly retainer plus a percentage of every sale you help generate, so I’m searching for someone who wants to live and breathe BumpBan—not a one-off freelancer.
To be considered, send: 1. Brief ideas on how you’d make this launch a success. 2. Links to past work that shows both web build and influencer/affiliate wins. 3. A snapshot of relevant experience with e-commerce platforms, creator outreach, and performance tracking.
Review the product here first: https://www.getbumpban.com/ If you’re dedicated, smart, and creative, let’s get BumpBan in the hands of people who need it—fast.

item.title: Google Merchant Center Product Feed Setup
item.description:
30-250 USD | Freelancer Wanted: Google Merchant Center Setup & Product Listing Specialist
Project Title: Set Up Google Merchant Center and List Products for Mind Body Soul Oil
About Our Business
Mind Body Soul Oil is an established natural wellness products business with its own e-commerce website:
https://www.mindbodysouloil.com
We manufacture and sell natural topical wellness products, including oils, creams, lotions, and personal-care products.
We are looking for an experienced freelancer to complete our Google setup, resolve existing product listing issues, and help make our eligible products available through Google's free product listings.
Project Requirements
The freelancer will be responsible for the following:
Review our existing Google Merchant Center account and verify that it is properly configured.
Investigate an existing product that Google has identified as not approved and determine the exact reason for its disapproval.
Verify and claim our business website in Google Merchant Center.
Review our existing e-commerce website and determine the best method for connecting our product catalog to Google Merchant Center.
Set up the necessary product feed or integration to submit our eligible products.
Review product titles, descriptions, photographs, pricing, availability, and other required product information.
Review Google's healthcare-related product policies and determine which of our products are eligible for listing.
Correct any technical errors or missing information that prevent eligible products from being approved.
Configure Google Merchant Center for Google's free product listings.
Test the setup and provide a report showing which products have been successfully submitted, approved, or rejected, including the reasons for any remaining disapprovals.
Mandatory Google Account Requirement
Anyone bidding on this project must have an active Google account.
All access will be provided through Google's official user permission system. The business owner will retain full ownership and administrative control of the Merchant Center account.
Important Project Conditions
Our website is hosted through Network Solutions and has an existing online shopping cart.
We already have an established Google Merchant Center account.
We want to utilize Google's FREE product listings.
We are NOT interested in purchasing Google Ads or running paid advertising campaigns.
We want the freelancer to perform the actual setup and technical work rather than simply provide instructions.
We expect the freelancer to follow Google's policies and not attempt to circumvent product restrictions.
Freelancer Qualifications
Applicants should have:
Demonstrated experience setting up Google Merchant Center accounts.
Experience with Google Shopping free product listings.
Experience creating and managing e-commerce product feeds.
Experience working with Network Solutions or comparable e-commerce platforms.
Knowledge of Google's product approval and healthcare-related policies.
A proven track record of resolving product disapprovals and account issues.
An active Google account and the ability to accept authorized Merchant Center access.
Project Deliverables
Upon completion, we expect:
A properly configured Google Merchant Center account.
Our website verified and claimed.
An operational product feed or integration.
All eligible products submitted for Google's review.
Resolution of existing product listing issues where possible.
A written report detailing the results and any products that remain ineligible.
Pricing
Please provide a fixed-price quotation for completing this project.
When responding, please include:
Examples of similar Google Merchant Center projects you have completed.
Your experience with wellness products or topical personal-care products.
Your proposed fixed price.
Your estimated completion time.
We are looking for an experienced professional who can take responsibility for completing this project from beginning to end.
Thank you for your interest.

item.title: Comprehensive Website UX Design Review
item.description:
30-250 USD | I’ve just launched a new site and need a fresh, expert eye on it. My priority is improving the overall design and ease of use so potential customers find every page intuitive, visually appealing, and effortless to navigate.
Please explore the entire site—not just the homepage—flagging any layout inconsistencies, confusing flows, clunky interactions, or accessibility gaps that might distract or frustrate visitors. I’m especially interested in practical, clearly explained fixes I can pass straight to my developer or tackle myself.
Deliverables • A concise report (PDF or Google Doc) outlining each issue you spot, why it matters, and a specific, actionable recommendation to resolve it. • Annotated screenshots or short Loom clips for complex points. • A prioritised checklist so I know which changes will have the biggest impact on user experience first.
I’ll share the URL as soon as we start. If you have a proven eye for modern UI/UX best practices and can translate observations into clear next steps, I’d love your insight.
